name: PostHog
summary: Product analytics, session replay and feature flags.

flows.title: Create a trends insight
steps: Go to Product analytics in the sidebar and click New insight in the top right. Trends is the default insight type.

To change the event plotted, click the dropdown to the right of the A icon and pick an event or action. The series counts Total count by default; its count dropdown offers other metrics, such as Unique users or Daily active users.
To look at a subset, click the icon next to the event name, then Add filter, and pick a property.
Click Last 7 days to choose another date range, and pick how events are grouped.
Click Save in the top right. Add to dashboard puts the saved insight on a dashboard.

flows.title: Create a feature flag
steps: Go to the Feature Flags tab and click New.
Enter the flag key your code uses to evaluate the flag, and a description.
In the Served value section, choose the flag type: a release toggle (boolean), multiple variants with rollout percentages, or remote config.
Set the release conditions, the property filters a user must match and the rollout percentage.

flows.title: Watch session recordings
steps: Open the Replay page. From an insight, clicking a data point lists the persons with a Watch recording button.
To narrow the list, click Show filters and filter by date, active duration, activity counts, events, properties and more.
To keep that list, click Add to "Saved filters". It then appears on the Shared filters tab for everyone in the project.
Pick a recording to play it. Press C or click Comment to leave a comment for your team.
